answer_1.quote: We present CLARIFYDELPHI, an interactive system that learns to ask questions to elicit salient context.

answer_2.quote: We report two automatic evaluation metrics. To measure informativeness we use an off-the-shelf QA model trained on SQuAD 2.0 from AllenNLP ... We also report the average maximum BERTScore between a generated question and one of the 5 gold questions in δ-CLARIFY.

answer_4.quote: We therefore perform human evaluation of the models' outputs on Amazon Mechanical Turk on the 500 test set instances from δ-CLARIFY.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers are asked to rate the question along three different attributes: Grammaticality (Is the question grammatical?), Relevance (Is the question relevant and plausible to the situation?), and Informativeness (Does the question access new information or regurgitate the situation?). Additionally, ... we aim to evaluate the defeasibility of the questions, e.g. how well the generated questions can elicit weakener or strengthener answers.
